Hey! Your PR title `Fix MCP object array tool schemas` doesn't follow conventional commit format.

Please update it to start with one of:
- `feat:` or `feat(scope):` new feature
- `fix:` or `fix(scope):` bug fix
- `docs:` or `docs(scope):` documentation changes
- `chore:` or `chore(scope):` maintenance tasks
- `refactor:` or `refactor(scope):` code refactoring
- `test:` or `test(scope):` adding or updating tests

Where `scope` is the package name (e.g., `app`, `desktop`, `opencode`).

See [CONTRIBUTING.md](../blob/dev/CONTRIBUTING.md#pr-titles) for details.

**Update:** I have isolated the root cause. This is a provider-side (DeepInfra) issue with their OpenAI-compatibility layer for DeepSeek-V4-Flash.

Through raw API testing, I’ve confirmed that their tool-call extractor fails specifically when the model's output contains angle brackets (`<`, `>`). Plain text works, but HTML/Svelte code results in empty strings in the tool `arguments`. Even when the arguments string returns as empty, the completion_tokens count shows activity. This confirms the model is indeed generating the code, but the provider-side extraction is failing to serialize it into the JSON response.

I have reported this to the DeepInfra team. For anyone else running into this, the current workaround is to use a different provider (like OpenRouter) which handles the DSML extraction correctly.
